title: UAP Task Force members confirm the egg was NHI

tellings.quote: it was also confirmed to me by ranking members of the UAP task force that that is exactly what we ran into that night, that that was NHI.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an egg-shaped object he says he encountered one night. He says senior members of the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study unidentified aerial objects, later confirmed to him that what he ran into was NHI, meaning non-human intelligence. If true, it would mean officials privately agreed that the object was not made by people.
